scope: Code/protocol-only review of the frozen C11 assemble1928/SpatialTargetQueryHead actually reused by C17. No model import/forward, feature arrays, source predictions, current, or V112.
conclusion_KO: 공간 정보가 전혀 없는 표현은 아니다. q 중심 crop과 context patch의 q 위치 샘플링, ViT positional embedding을 통해 정보가 암묵적으로 남는다. 다만 head는 전체 patch 격자를 받지 않고 5개 요약 벡터와 8개 scalar만 받아 공간 배치를 강하게 압축한다. 이것이 성능 병목인지는 old-loss 대조 전후의 증거가 필요하다.

actual_chain.protocol_feature_operator: Exact C11 assemble T/Q/F/C/P384 each +4cos/3fractions/Qinside=1928; exact C8/C9 preprocessing unchanged
actual_chain.protocol_availability: finite non-sentinel native continuous AND nearest query support AND stored/canonical RGB96 central4valid AND context any; Qinside feature only; no weak label/construction status input
actual_chain.same_native_composition: Fresh input RGB96 and context224 must replay from the same native original/composed fullRGB; centre aliases assert exact1928 parity. Existing feature packets are reused without changing this frozen representation.

feature_layout.name: T
feature_layout.spatial_compression: One descriptor for context image; no spatial grid passed to head.

feature_layout.name: Q
feature_layout.definition: Bilinear sample of raw 16x16 context patch tokens at native q transformed by context box, then L2
feature_layout.spatial_compression: One q-conditioned token; final-layer global self-attention means it is not a strictly local pixel/ownership measurement.

feature_layout.name: F
feature_layout.definition: L2-normalized CLS of full stored RGB96, resized directly to224
feature_layout.spatial_compression: One descriptor over the original q-centred crop.

feature_layout.name: C
feature_layout.definition: L2-normalized CLS of literal RGB96[:,32:64,32:64], resized directly to224
feature_layout.spatial_compression: One descriptor for central32; surrounding central spatial topology is not separately presented.

feature_layout.name: P
feature_layout.definition: Mean RAW x_norm_patchtokens[7:9,7:9] from full96 view, THEN L2
feature_layout.spatial_compression: Four centre tokens averaged; their quadrant-specific ordering is not explicitly retained by this pooling.

Q_geometry.grid: FP32(2*u-1); grid_sample bilinear/padding_mode=border/align_corners=False on raw context patch tokens
Q_geometry.Q_inside: finite non-sentinel q, finite positive context box, context support>0, closed 0<=u<=1
Q_geometry.outside: Q exactly zero, Qinside=0; Qoutside does not by itself change factual/model U

preprocessing.full_and_central: Literal uint8 RGB96 + bool valid; invalid filled with ImageNet mean before bilinear resize224 align_corners=False antialias=True and standard normalization. Central branch uses [32:64] before resize.
preprocessing.context: Exact native V107 bilinear context224, followed by invalid mean fill/ImageNet normalization. Source context comes from finite non-sentinel q8 minmax as fixed in C14/wide corpus; no GT r sampling.
preprocessing.normalization: Each of T/Q/F/C/P independently L2 eps1e-12 after sample/pool. No-support descriptor is zero. Valid fractions/Qinside remain scalar features.
preprocessing.P_support: P zeroed unless literal stored RGB96 central4 samples are all valid; it is not an observed class.

head_contract.output: One external hidden raw logit; raw sign0 decoding is outside this feature-to-logit forward. No learned geometric-S output.

implicitly_retained: Native q determines local96 crop centre and L determines its field of view.
Context q-relative position chooses Q via normalized box coordinate.
DINO adds learned/interpolated positional embeddings before all transformer blocks; final CLS/patch tokens can encode spatial appearance and global context.
Named branches identify context versus local96 versus central32 and centre pooled patch, with exact relative query phase.
not_explicit_head_inputs: native q_xy or L or signed u/v coordinate values
expected physical cue identity or part token
GT reference r, uncertainty region, mask, depth, pose, labels, donor ID, source/fold ID
ordered 16x16 patch grid or original RGB pixels
spatial_information.q8_role: All8 queries determine the context box upstream; their full coordinate array is not concatenated into the head input.
spatial_information.attention_limitation: Q and P are final globally contextualized patch tokens; their sampling locations do not establish pixel-only causality, target ownership, or a sharply bounded receptive field.

previous_changes.V101: Trainable copied C1 CNN on central32, query-phase bilinear sample of its 4x4 map, plus strong frozen C1 scalar prior. This differs from the later frozen DINO descriptor+MLP route.
previous_changes.V111: Already added spatial Q from context patch grid and pooled P from local centre2x2, plus descriptor differences/products. Re-proposing a single query token or central crop alone would repeat existing work.

one_minimal_next_representation_candidat.status: OPTIONAL prospective candidate only, after old-loss ablation evidence; not implemented or selected.
one_minimal_next_representation_candidat.change: Preserve a fixed ordered 3x3 query-relative local patch stencil instead of collapsing local spatial evidence into a single centre mean P.
one_minimal_next_representation_candidat.definition: Use the SAME frozen full96 DINO raw16x16 token grid. Bilinearly sample at token-index coordinates (3.5,7.5,11.5) per axis, row-major, each vector normalized separately. These correspond to fixed q-relative local offsets {-L/4,0,+L/4} per axis; no GT r, native slot or target-specific recentering.
one_minimal_next_representation_candidat.difference: Unlike V101, no learned CNN/residual/C1 prior. Unlike V111, head retains multiple ordered query-relative positions rather than one Q and one averaged P.
one_minimal_next_representation_candidat.invariants: Same source labels/q/L/folds/encoder and raw0 decoder; keep factual availability independent of label. A future comparison would need fresh readout dimensions and source-only fixed evaluation, not a claim that this works.
one_minimal_next_representation_candidat.limits: Still globally contextualized patch vectors; no exact pixel ownership or expected-cue identity is introduced. Raw token grids are not present in existing1928 feature caches, so actual extraction would need a separately authorized producer replay. This review executes none.

unproven: Whether compression is the dominant error mechanism.
Whether old-loss gradients oppose the new semantic task on identical inputs.
Whether an ordered stencil improves held-out source performance or actual task performance.

read_scope_note.incidental: One initial broad rg over the assets directory also pattern-scanned a checkpoint binary and reported a binary match. No checkpoint was deserialized, tensors inspected, or parameters used; subsequent reads were explicit code/JSON paths.
